question: open restaurants Baixa Chiado box
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, operating_status FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'restaurant' AND operating_status = 'open' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.14, 38.707, -9.12, 38.72, 4326))

question: historic sites within 500m Praça do Comércio
sql: WITH pt AS (SELECT ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-9.1393, 38.7079), 4326), 4326, 3763, always_xy := true) AS g) SELECT p.id, p.names.primary AS name, ST_AsGeoJSON(p.geometry) AS geo FROM lisbon_places p, pt WHERE p.taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry, ST_Transform(ST_Buffer(pt.g, 500), 3763, 4326, always_xy := true))

question: residential buildings Parque das Nações bbox
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, height, num_floors FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE subtype = 'residential' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.10, 38.77, -9.05, 38.80, 4326))

question: restaurants inside commercial building footprints
sql: SELECT p.id AS place_id, p.names.primary AS place_name, b.id AS building_id, b.subtype FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' AND b.subtype = 'commercial' LIMIT 200

question: restaurants touching building footprints
sql: SELECT p.id AS place_id, p.names.primary AS place_name, b.id AS building_id FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Touches(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' LIMIT 200

question: gabled roof buildings Alfama bbox
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, num_floors, roof_shape FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE roof_shape = 'gabled' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.13, 38.71, -9.11, 38.715, 4326))
